mprDimBias.h18: The text width calculation depends on the font. With some fonts, the software's calculated width may be greater than the width of the text drawn by Revit. In this case, you can use a width factor that will be taken into account when calculating the width of the text programmatically
mprDimBias.h19: You must specify a number between 0.1 and 2.0 for the text width factor
